about: The outside tools the level port's Watson build was made with (toolchain.py checks a machine against it; --record rewrites the values from this machine). A tool is found by its environment variable (paths.py); 'pin' is what the reference build used: a different value is reported, and only --strict makes it an error, but a different build of a tool can change the outputs.

tools.name: numpy
tools.needed_by: every tool; in the material result cache's key

tools.name: Pillow
tools.needed_by: materials, images; in the material result cache's key

tools.name: q3map2 (the chunks)
tools.needed_by: build_watson collision: the chunks, cooker A (exact_planes, brush_cook, brush_bin; the inputs' --q3map2-chunks)

tools.name: WolvenKit.CLI
tools.needed_by: --extract (sectors, fetches, the moon), the decal and fx fetches (the inputs' wolvenkit_cli), cp77_ads_fetch; CP2077 2.5 or later needs 10.0.0-beta.1 or later (9.0.1 reads neither its sectors nor all of its TweakDB)

tools.name: Cyberpunk 2077
tools.needed_by: --extract and the generators: CP2077 2.5 or later (the reference kits' extraction kept in the work folder is 2.31's)
